question: In December 2023, which eminent agricultural economist from Kerala was conferred the distinguished title of ISAE Fellow 2023 by the Indian Society of Agricultural Economics (ISAE)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. P Indira Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Dr. P Indira Devi, an eminent agricultural economist from Kerala, was conferred the prestigious title of **ISAE Fellow 2023** by the Indian Society of Agricultural Economics (ISAE) in December 2023.
 
• She is known for her extensive contributions to **agricultural economics**, particularly in the areas of sustainable agriculture and environmental economics.
 
• Dr. Indira Devi has conducted impactful research
